description: This file contains utility functions related to date handling, including generating HTML select options for months, days, years, and date/time pickers, as well as timestamp validation and locale-based date format conversions.

methods.name: create_month_option_list
methods.description: Generates HTML options for months, optionally marking one as selected.

methods.name: create_numeric_month_option_list
methods.description: Creates options for months in numeric form, with optional selection.

methods.name: create_day_option_list
methods.description: Creates options for days of the month, with optional selection.

methods.name: create_year_option_list
methods.description: Generates HTML options for years from the current year down to 2000, with optional selection.

methods.name: create_date_selection_set
methods.description: Creates a comprehensive HTML date picker input set including calendar display and optional time selection.

methods.name: create_range_option_list
methods.description: Generates a list of <option> tags for a range of numeric values, marking one as selected.

methods.name: checkTimeStamp
methods.description: Validates if a string matches expected timestamp formats and represents a real date.

methods.name: locateDateToISO
methods.description: Converts locale-specific date strings into ISO format based on a locale's date format.
